India asks UN rights bodies to shun politicization and selectivity

India has called on United Nations human rights mechanisms to avoid politicization and selectivity in their work. This appeal was made in the context of the uncontested election of 15 countries to a top UN human rights body, a process that has drawn criticism from human rights groups.
